title: Subscribed IP lists
help: Download province, carrier or blocklist IP ranges from a URL and refresh them on a schedule, then reference them in a site's IP access control and path rules. One IP, CIDR or start-end range per line. frps instances and the IP access control of port forwarding, protocol routing and STUN rules can reference them too
urlHelp: For Chinese provinces and cities you can use metowolf/iplist data/cncity/<division code>.txt. If the content cannot be parsed, the previous list is kept
